outcome: age at type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) diagnosis
cohort: The study enrolled 409 patients diagnosed with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) in Bauru, Sao Paulo, Brazil, between 1981 and 2023.
finding: Delivery type and filiation order were the only factors statistically significantly associated with an early age at T1DM diagnosis.
mod_finding: Patients born through cesarean section showed a 28.6% lower age at T1DM diagnosis compared to those born through vaginal delivery.
followup_time: Up to the age of T1DM diagnosis, with a median age of 10.3 years (interquartile range 6.4-15.5 years).
